name: IFS
notes: Verified 2026-09-19: listing page links to jobs.smartrecruiters.com/IFS1/<id>-<slug> detail pages. Each detail page has real schema.org Microdata (itemprop attributes, not JSON-LD script) with title/jobLocation/datePosted/employmentType/hiringOrganization/description/qualifications/responsibilities. No validThrough field observed. NOTE: address itemprop fields (addressLocality/addressCountry) were wrong/stale on the one job checked (said Pune, India for a Colombo-based role) -- trust the visible formattedAddress text over the meta address fields.

name: Seylan Bank PLC
notes: Verified 2026-09-19: no JSON-LD or microdata. Postings are scanned JPG images of the notice, not parseable text at all. Not viable for this connector.

name: Commercial Bank of Ceylon
notes: Verified 2026-09-19: no JSON-LD/microdata. Postings are inline plain HTML text (title + closing date readable) with no detail pages, applications via external Google Forms. Could be revisited later with a plain custom parser if the JSON-LD-first approach proves too thin, but out of v1 scope per the plan.

name: WSO2
notes: Verified 2026-09-19: no JSON-LD/microdata, but has clean per-job detail pages with predictable URLs. Same as Commercial Bank -- candidate for a future plain-HTML parser, not in v1 scope.
